svg.title: Professional experience
svg.desc: SOC Analyst at Silverspace, September 2025 to present, remote. Junior SOC Analyst at Vizva Consultancy Services, September 2021 to August 2023, India. Responsibilities and CV-listed achievements are presented separately.
svg.text: Investigate alerts in Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR.
Support identity investigations, threat hunting, and response automation.
• Triaged 2,800+ alerts and escalated 140 confirmed incidents.
• Developed 22 KQL analytic rules and 9 Sentinel playbooks.
Monitor security events with Splunk and EDR; investigate phishing.
Escalate validated incidents and coordinate remediation activities.
• Analysed 650 phishing emails and escalated 220 validated incidents.
• Coordinated 140 remediation tickets and documented analyst procedures.
Employment details and achievements are drawn from my CV.
